boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer pipe casing exchanging heat with warm environment via convection

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall swept by cooling water via convection; shape optimised

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight / prescribed outer-surface flux

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

objective.name: J
objective.description: Minimising J keeps the casing cold, i.e. maximises heat absorbed from the environment through \Gamma_o and delivered to the cooling water.

state_equation.description: Linear convection-diffusion problem for the temperature u.
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C u_C \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint problem for the adjoint temperature \tilde u.
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} h_C \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer pipe casing exchanging heat with warm environment via convection

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall swept by cooling water via convection; shape optimised

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: casing temperature weight / prescribed outer-surface flux

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

expressions.name: k
expressions.rationale: Effective thermal conductivity interpolating between solid aluminium and air; in the weak form k\chi reduces to k_0 in the solid because \chi^2=\chi and (1-\chi)\chi=0.

expressions.name: heat_flux
expressions.rationale: Fourier heat flux, standard derived quantity for thermal problems.

optimization_config.rationale: Mesh file from extracted spec. hmin/hmax chosen around 1/200 and 1/20 of the 1 m pipe cross-section to resolve the inner cooling channel without excessive cost. diffusion=1e-4 and v0=5e-3 are standard level-set regularisation and velocity scales. 30 iterations balance runtime and convergence. Initial level set is the signed distance to the initial inner radius r_0. boundary_labels/fixed_labels preserve extracted design roles (Gamma_i label 2 design, Gamma_o label 3 fixed).
